facts.text: Procedural generation automatically builds many different virtual sites from rules and parameter ranges instead of modeling each site by hand.
facts.quote: Procedural generation builds many different virtual sites automatically from rules and parameter ranges instead of modeling each site by hand.

facts.text: A procedural site-generation script can specify a pit 200–400 m wide, benches 10–15 m high, ramp curvature, a gravel-roughness range, 3–8 parked machines and 2–10 workers in high-visibility clothing.
facts.quote: a pit 200 to 400 m wide, benches 10 to 15 m high, a ramp with this curvature, gravel roughness in this range, 3 to 8 parked machines, 2 to 10 workers in high-visibility clothing.

facts.text: Running a procedural site-generation script with a new random seed produces a new, plausible site.
facts.quote: Each time the script runs with a new random seed it produces a new, plausible site.

facts.text: Once procedural-generation rules exist, hundreds of virtual-site variants cost almost nothing to produce.
facts.quote: Hundreds of variants cost almost nothing once the rules exist

facts.text: Every object in the described procedurally generated sites comes with a perfect label.
facts.quote: every object comes with a perfect label

facts.text: Procedural generation allows a new sensor height or a deliberate edge case, such as a child-sized object half hidden behind a dump body, to be placed exactly where a test requires it.
facts.quote: a new sensor height or a deliberate edge case (a child-sized object half hidden behind a dump body) can be placed exactly where the test needs it

facts.text: The booklet found procedural generation to have the strongest off-road track record, citing agricultural fields, synthetic forest plots for laser scanning, procedural construction scenes and an open off-road simulator.
facts.quote: The booklet found that this family has the strongest off-road track record

facts.text: One procedural-generation tool for agricultural fields reported a 9.9% average gap between synthetic and real images on a segmentation task.
facts.quote: agricultural fields (one tool reported a 9.9% average gap between synthetic and real images on a segmentation task)

facts.text: The booklet cited 1,000 synthetic forest plots for laser scanning as off-road evidence for procedural generation.
facts.quote: 1,000 synthetic forest plots for laser scanning

facts.text: An open off-road simulator cited by the booklet generates terrain with controllable roughness, vegetation, haze and moonlight.
facts.quote: an open off-road simulator that generates terrain with controllable roughness, vegetation, haze and moonlight

facts.text: Procedural generation has a model-risk weakness: apparently broad parameter ranges are worthless if the generation rules omit the real structure that causes failures.
facts.quote: Its weakness is "model risk": parameter ranges that look broad are worthless if the rules omit the real structure that causes failures

facts.text: A procedural generator cannot create a category that nobody encoded; real captured sites expose unexpected clutter and correlations, whereas procedural sites reproduce only what was written down.
facts.quote: a generator cannot create a category nobody encoded. Real captured sites expose unexpected clutter and correlations; procedural ones only reproduce what was written down

facts.text: For reproducible procedural-generation tests, freeze random seeds, generator versions, assets and material libraries; otherwise a failure found today may not be replayable in three months.
facts.quote: freeze random seeds, generator versions, assets and material libraries, or a failure found today may not be replayable in three months

facts.text: The booklet recommends a portfolio of procedural families anchored by a few surveyed real sites, turning 100 or more site types into a manageable set of parameterized archetypes.
facts.quote: Procedural families are how 100 or more site types become a manageable set of parameterized archetypes, which is the booklet's recommended portfolio when anchored by a few surveyed real sites
